Need verify no direct edges from root/scope-1 to members/internal nodes. Already out edges show only to N2, N5, N4. Good. But requirement "实际可达性 root 与 scope-1 能到达 discussion 与 collab 入口、不能到达任何成员". Reachability through entry? Root->discussion entry, does it then reach members via discussion entry? There are entry->member edges with channels? Need analyze whether root signal chained could reach members. In Nexarbor signal propagation: signal enters discussion with channel "discussion", and emitted outward edges from discussion to members may have allow channels that include discussion? The preset wiring likely has entry outbound edges with channels like discussion.round? Let's inspect edges around entries. Also "能到达...不能到达成员" likely means reachability test via BFS considering channels and strength. There might be a host reachability tool? No validate allowed. Maybe inspect_edges enough.

But could entry forward into members? In actual reachability, root signal on discussion channel enters entry, then propagation through entry to members maybe allowed if edges channels include discussion. Let's inspect entry outbound edges.
